input.summary:
Implemented a Task Management API in TypeScript using Node.js built-in modules with in-memory data stores and an in-memory event bus. Components include:
- Event Bus (src/event-bus.ts) for pub/sub communication
- Services (each in its own file): User, Project, Task, Comment, Notification (src/services/*.ts)
- API Router (src/router.ts) using http module, handling all routes with JSON bodies
- Main entry point (src/main.ts) wiring services and starting HTTP server
- Demo script (src/demo.ts) that starts a server on port 3001 and exercises all features end-to-end: create users, create project, add members, create tasks, assign tasks, change status (enforcing forward-only transitions), add comments, and check/mark notifications.

Inter-service communication strictly goes through Event Bus. NotificationService subscribes to task.assigned, task.statusChanged, and comment.added events. The router enriches comment creation by including taskTitle, authorName, and task assigneeId in the event payload to enable NotificationService to notify the task assignee without direct service calls.

Added tsconfig.json configured for Node16 module resolution and @types/node. Verified type-checking with `npx tsc --noEmit` passes. The demo runs with `npx tsx src/demo.ts` and shows the full flow. The system starts with `npx tsx src/main.ts`.
